race.comment: EXTREME MAKEOVER (12) has the right profile third-up, coming off a Belmont Park NMW1Y second where she was beaten a length and a half after racing wide throughout. Her Northam third prior was also sound, and three placings from three starts around 1000m make her the one to beat with weight relief. SHORT STRAW (10) is the danger after closing strongly for third at Belmont Park despite early tightening and late interference; this is easier company than that metro assignment and the distance record is solid. MAYTHISBETHEONE (7) resumes after eight months but brings a very consistent maiden record, including thirds at Pinjarra Scarpside and this track when well found in betting. NICE SORT (9) was plain before the break, yet her Belmont Park fourth two back reads well enough. Can make an impression on resumption. LONG LAUGH (1) can play a role.
